item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 13 #SLPRSD
Issued at 12:00 AM 13 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Casiguran, Irosin, SantaMagdalena), #OrientalMindoro(PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro), #Romblon(Romblon, Calatrava, SanAgustin, SanAndres, Odiongan, SantaMaria, Alcantara, Looc, Ferrol, SanJose, Banton, Corcuera), #Marinduque(Mogpog, Boac, Gasan and Buenavista) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #CamarinesNorte(Basud, Mercedes, Daet), #CamarinesSur(Siruma, Tinambac, Lagonoy, Garchitorena, Caramoan), #Sorsogon(Gubat, PrietoDiaz, Barcelona, Bulusan), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, SanFernando, Magdiwang, Concepcion), #OrientalMindoro(Baco, CityOfCalapan, Naujan, Victoria, Bulalacao and Mansalay) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
